decisions.reason: As a track-system adapter, it is very close to the firm's existing electrical and lighting know-how, so management can readily learn from use feedback and improve it at low risk.
An LED luminaire fits the firm's core competences, but as a single 2018 lighting product it is somewhat more exposed to replacement by newer LED lines than more system-embedded products.

A home automation server box is more knowledge-distant from a traditional lighting and electrical equipment base, making it harder for the firm to absorb market feedback and refine the product effectively.

A luminaire family builds directly on the firm's established product and development capabilities, and the later launch of additional LED lighting families suggests the firm has the absorptive capacity to sustain and update this line.
